title: Privacy-Preserving Generation of Clinical Narratives from Medical Terminologies
abstract: arXiv:2509.10882v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In high-stakes domains such as healthcare, privacy concerns severely limit the use of real-world training data. Differentially private (DP) synthetic data offers a promising alternative with formal privacy guarantees, but achieving strong utility remains challenging for clinical note generation due to domain specificity and long-form text complexity. We present Term2Note, a method for synthesising full-length clinical notes under DP constraints. By structurally separating content and form, Term2Note generates section-wise note content conditioned on medical terms, with terms and notes privatised under separate DP constraints, and applies a DP quality maximiser to improve outputs. Experiments demonstrate that Term2Note produces synthetic notes with statistical properties closely aligned with real clinical notes, and that downstream models trained on these notes achieve performance comparable to those trained on real clinical data. translated_title: 基于医学术语的隐私保护临床叙述生成
translated_abstract: 在医疗保健等高风险领域，隐私问题严重限制了真实世界训练数据的使用。差分隐私（DP）合成数据提供了一种具有正式隐私保证的有前景的替代方案，但由于领域的专业性和长文本的复杂性，在临床笔记生成方面实现强实用性仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了Term2Note，这是一种在差分隐私约束下合成全长临床笔记的方法。通过在结构上分离内容与形式，Term2Note基于医学术语生成分节的笔记内容，其中术语和笔记分别在独立的差分隐私约束下进行隐私化处理，并应用差分隐私质量最大化器来改进输出。实验表明，Term2Note生成的合成笔记在统计特性上与真实临床笔记高度一致，并且在这些合成笔记上训练的下游模型达到了与在真实临床数据上训练的模型相当的性能。
tldr: 提出了Term2Note方法，通过结构上分离内容与形式、在独立差分隐私约束下分别对医学术语和临床笔记进行隐私化处理，实现了高质量的全长临床笔记合成，其统计特性接近真实临床笔记，且下游模型性能与使用真实数据训练的结果相当。
en_tdlr: Term2Note synthesizes full-length clinical notes under differential privacy by structurally separating content and form, privatizing medical terms and notes under separate DP constraints, achieving statistical fidelity to real notes and downstream performance comparable to real clinical data.
